facts: Parties: Pemberton Software Ltd (Buyer), Pemberton Analytics Ltd (Seller); the Company is Quayside Bioscience plc.
This Agreement is dated 22 February 2027; Closing is scheduled for 4 May 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 5 years after Closing.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 22 February 2027), either party may terminate.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 18 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 12 months after termination of employment.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 7 July 2027.
